'''Ithor Delicacies''' was a [[Diet/Legends|vegetarian]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] stand in [[Isttu Village]] onboard the [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']], an [[Ithorian Herdship]] that operated shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. During this [[Time/Legends|time]], Ithor Delicacies sold [[Hoyy seed]]s, [[Liwi fruit/Legends|liwi fruit]], and [[Covado salad]]s.<ref name="Graveyard of Alderaan" />

*''[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]'' {{Reprint|Graveyard of Alderaan}}
